title: Summarize a short support update
prompt: Summarize the following update in one sentence: The support team resolved all outstanding customer tickets and closed out the sprint a day early.

metadata.notes: Correct: a one-sentence summary capturing both that tickets were resolved and the sprint finished early, with no fabricated details.
metadata.grading_method: manual (reviewed 2026-09-23, V2.6 Phase 1) - both required facts are pure concepts with no numeric or named-entity anchor ('resolved', 'finished early'); a correct paraphrase ('all tickets closed', 'wrapped up ahead of schedule') would false-fail a substring check. Not auto-graded rather than accept an unreliable check.
